board: Ground: verified local resources, Newark, NJ

checks.result: Confirmed on the provider food pantry page: pantry at 22 Grant Street, Newark, NJ, open Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays from 10:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.

Confirmed on the provider food pantry page: food at no cost, pantry schedule every Saturday 9:00 to 11:00 a.m., current ID needed to register. The church address, 520 Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd, Newark, NJ 07102, is confirmed on the provider site church pages.

Confirmed on the provider site: free meals for people in the Newark area, meal service Tuesday to Saturday with breakfast 8:00 to 9:00 a.m. and lunch 11:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m., at 22 Mulberry Street, Newark, NJ 07102, shown in the footer of the provider pages.
Confirmed on the Catholic Charities page: supervised shelter open 24 hours a day, seven days a week, 145 beds, meals, clothing and case management, at 47 Miller Street, Newark, NJ 07114.

Confirmed on the Catholic Charities page: emergency family shelter for up to 15 families with three meals a day and case management, at 368 South 7th Street, Newark, NJ 07103. The page states no hours, so the listing says so plainly.

Confirmed on the Covenant House New Jersey page: open 24 hours a day, seven days a week, all services free, for youth age 18 to 21, with the Newark Residential site at 330 Washington Street, Newark, NJ 07102.

Confirmed on the provider locations page: medical and dental services at 741 Broadway, Newark, NJ 07104, with the hours listed in this record. The provider home page states no patient is denied service due to inability to pay.

drops.reason: Provider own site says direct services were temporarily suspended at the end of March 2020 and guests were connected to The Bowery Mission in New York. Not an open Newark offer today.

drops.candidate: Mary Eliza Mahoney Health Center, City of Newark
drops.reason: City provider pages state no cost care and list services, but no single provider page ties one site address to matching hours. The city directory lists several sites with different hours.

drops.candidate: NJCRI, North Jersey Community Research Initiative
drops.reason: Provider home page states medical care, drop-in centers and a food pantry and gives the address, but states no hours and no free or sliding scale terms.
Provider site gives a Summit headquarters address. No Newark walk-in site address and hours are stated on the provider site.
The provider shelter program page returned no readable content when fetched. The shelter is not listed. The food pantry was verified on a separate provider page.

drops.candidate: St. Bridget's Emergency Shelter, Catholic Charities
drops.reason: Provider page describes a small shelter for men living with HIV/AIDS with a voucher requirement, but states no street address for the shelter.

drops.candidate: St. John's Soup Kitchen women's health and clinic offers
drops.reason: Partner and directory pages describe clinic services, but the provider own pages fetched state meals and basic necessities only, with no clinic hours.

expiry_rule: Every listing expires 30 days after the date it was verified. A listing past its expiry is shown as stale, never silently.

listings.offer: Food pantry serving Newark. The provider says the pantry stocks food that can make a meal and is one of the largest food pantries in Essex County.
listings.when: Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays, 10:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.

listings.offer: Emergency food assistance at no cost for registered clients, and emergency help when the pantry is able. Current ID is required for registration.
listings.provider: Pierre Toussaint Food Pantry, St. Mary's Church
listings.where: 520 Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd, Newark, NJ 07102

listings.offer: Free hot meals for anyone who is hungry in the Newark area, plus basic necessities through partner organizations.
listings.when: Tuesday to Saturday. Breakfast 8:00 to 9:00 a.m., lunch 11:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m.

listings.offer: Emergency shelter for single women, men and families age 18 and over. 145 beds. Nutritious meals, clothing, case management, mental health, substance use and employment services.
listings.provider: Miller Street Pathways to Housing Center, Catholic Charities of the Archdiocese of Newark
listings.when: Open 24 hours a day, seven days a week, year round.

listings.offer: Emergency shelter for homeless Essex County families with children, up to 15 families. Three meals a day, case management, food and clothing. Families are referred from Essex County and City of Newark programs.
listings.provider: St. Rocco's Emergency Family Shelter, Catholic Charities of the Archdiocese of Newark
listings.when: Hours not stated on the provider page.

listings.offer: Free residential crisis center and drop-in help for youth age 18 to 21 facing homelessness or trafficking, including meals, clothing, health care, mental health care and case management.
listings.when: Open 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

listings.offer: Federally qualified health center with medical and dental services for children, adults and seniors. The provider home page states no patient is denied service due to inability to pay.
listings.when: Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. Saturday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Sunday, 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m.
